get.description:
Upgrades the connection to WebSocket for real-time document collaboration.
The server path is `/collab` and expects `doc` query parameter.
Authentication supports:
1) `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` header (preferred)
2) `token=<jwt>` query parameter fallback

Transport details:
- Binary protocol based on Yjs (`y-protocols/sync` and `y-protocols/awareness`)
- Maximum inbound frame size: 1 MB
- In production, non-HTTPS forwarded traffic is rejected

parameters.name: doc
parameters.description: Document identifier used as the collaboration room key.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: JWT token fallback when Authorization header is not sent.

401.description: Authentication failed; connection closed as unauthorized.

403.description: Forbidden due to inactive tenant/subscription or HTTPS enforcement in production.

1009.description: WebSocket closed because incoming message exceeded 1 MB.

usage.instruction: Open ws(s) connection to /collab with doc query parameter
Send Authorization Bearer token or token query fallback
Wait for initial sync step from server
Exchange sync and awareness binary frames
Handle close codes and reconnect client-side as needed
